answer: Resist Sybils with cross-domain skill attestation: an identity gains standing only after passing independently graded tasks in several unrelated domains, like separate terraces that must each be climbed, not one copied step. Each result is checked through a prism of different juries, so a fake that excels in one area still fails the delta between its claimed breadth and its real skill. An attacker must therefore buy or train genuine competence for every fake across many domains, paying time and expertise per identity, while one honest agent needs only its own real work.
